name: SPROUT
description: SPROUT is a dataset introduced to facilitate routing queries to the most cost-effective LLM that can deliver suitable responses, supporting evaluation of routing algorithms across a wide spectrum of queries with state-of-the-art LLMs.
reputation: A recent routing benchmark from the LLM routing literature that is cited as a practical testbed for cost-aware model selection, but it is still relatively new and not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Supports evaluation of LLM routing algorithms; complements existing benchmarks like Routerbench and open-LLM-leaderboard-v2.
